# CD Visuals Creative Media

> Brand development and creative consulting studio in Rochester, NY, led by founder and creative director Chris Dodd. Brand development, social media management and marketing, photography, and cinematic brand films for founders, ecommerce and fashion brands, and local businesses and organizations. Brand. Social. Film. Tagline: "Turning content into currency."

## Site
- [Home](https://cd-visuals.com/): One-page overview of every service, the comprehensive brand package, client testimonials, the founder's story, FAQs, and the project inquiry form.
- [Services](https://cd-visuals.com/#services): Brand Development; Social Media & Marketing; Photography & Cinematography, with what each does for a client's business and a short video from real client work for each.
- [Testimonials](https://cd-visuals.com/#testimonials): What clients including The Gathering Place Rochester, CRCDS, Shop GLD and Proper Grahamer say about working with Chris.
- [Brand packages](https://cd-visuals.com/#branding): Why a complete brand package (story, identity, website, launch content, print, social templates, personal brand) outperforms building piece by piece.
- [About Chris Dodd](https://cd-visuals.com/#about): Skateboarding roots, Los Angeles film and TV sets, a streetwear brand grown to over half a million in sales in under two years on content, and yearlong menswear campaigns.
- [FAQ](https://cd-visuals.com/#faq): Pricing approach, brand package contents, industries served, monthly social media management, weddings and drone work, one studio versus freelancers.
- [Contact](https://cd-visuals.com/#contact): Project inquiry form; phone 585-794-3225; email chrisdoddbr@gmail.com.
